messages:
maya: Quick status — runtime gate check for a small batch of new open models before we flip the catalog to 'public'. Models: seabird-7b, cinder-13b-oz, marula-3b-quant. Need owners/blocks and short plan by EOD.
Tom: what's blocking right now? :eyes:
maya: short list — licensing question on cinder (legal flagged non-commercial clause), marula quant needs perf + regression QA, seabird perf mostly OK but infra saw a memory spike with KV cache at seq=512.
rachael: tagging legal — @sanjay can you confirm the cinder license stance? We might need an exception for hosted inference.
sanjay (legal): saw the licensing note. cinder's upstream license currently prohibits commercial hosting. Legal can request an exception but we need a concise product-use statement + intended revisions from the model owner. ETA: EOD Tue once owner provides text. :calendar:
leo: perf quick readout for seabird-7b (p3dn-24): median per-token latency ~18ms, p50 decode ~140ms for 256 tokens, p99 ~210ms. Batch size 16 looks optimal for throughput. However, KV cache memory grows unexpectedly when sequence_len >= 512 — hitting OOM in our long-context smoke tests.
leo: snippet from local run:
```bash
# run summary
model=seabird-7b
hw=p3dn-24
batch=16
seq=512
mem_peak=87GB # unexpected
lat_p50=140ms
lat_p99=210ms
```
leo: I suspect a cache eviction bug in the runtime (KV pointer not freeing on truncation). Filing infra CR now.
Tom: thanks. Can you link the CR? I'll add it to the catalog gating checklist.
leo: https://redwood.internal/cr/4982 — title: "kv-cache-evict-fix"
maya: OK — gates I'm proposing before public launch for these models:
1) cinder-13b-oz: legal exception confirmed or model removed from hosted catalog
2) marula-3b-quant: runtime patch + canary rollout plan + eval pass
3) seabird-7b: infra CR merged or hotfix staged for KV issue
Tom: I can own the marula canary. Plan: route 5% traffic -> monitor latency/cost/quality for 24h -> bump if stable. Will post canary config shortly.
Tom: CR-assign -> runtime change for efficient quant routing is PR #4521, assigning to @kat for review.
kat: got it, I'll review PR #4521 this afternoon. ETA: 3pm PT.
catalog-bot: Canary plan created: `canary create --model=marula-3b-quant --route=5% --duration=24h --checks=latency,cost,eval-regressions`
maya: Rachael, can you own the regression evals for marula and seabird? Need a small prompt suite (<=200 prompts) covering summarization, instruction-following, and hallucination checks.
rachael: yes — will assemble prompt set and baseline outputs by tomorrow AM. Will include a few edge-case long-context prompts to hit seq=512.
maya: sanjay — if owner for cinder can produce the product-use paragraph today, we can escalate legal review and potentially unblock by Tue. If not, we'll mark cinder as "catalog-preview (no-host)" until we get clearance.
sanjay (legal): yep, send the statement to legal@redwood and I'll expedite. Also CC product for the hosting details.
ml-ingest-bot: Model metadata ingestion completed for seabird-7b and marula-3b-quant. cinder-13b-oz ingestion paused pending license status.
maya: action items / owners (quick):
- cinder license exception -> model owner + legal (sanjay) -> owner to send statement (owner?), target Tue
- marula canary + evals -> Tom (canary) + Rachael (evals) -> Tom to post canary config by EOD
- runtime KV fix -> Leo (reported CR #4982) + Kat (PR review #4521) -> aim for hotfix or staged rollout before public flip
- catalog config: remove cinder from hosted routes until legal ok -> Catalog team (maya/Tom)
Tom: I'll also add a short note to the launch checklist doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/catalog-launch-checklist — section "open-model legal gating" updated.
rachael: one more: can someone confirm which eval harness to use? Should I use `evals/redwood/production-v2` or the staging harness?
maya: use production-v2 for gold baselines, run locally against canary endpoint for marula. Tag results with `catalog/launch/2027-02`.
kat: PR review in progress. If small changes, can merge and ship a hotfix canary tonight.
maya: thanks all. If nothing else, I'll follow up with a short readout in the launch channel tomorrow AM. Ping me if you hit a blocker. :white_check_mark:
Tom: ack. I'll post the canary config once it's live.
leo: re infra — adding a lightweight runtime guard for seq>=512 to avoid OOM until we fix the eviction logic. Will flip guard off after patch merged.
maya: perfect. Summarizing last_message_ts=1791054988 for thread close; if we need to continue, start a new thread referencing this ts."
